scientific_integrity: Unrestricted formulas have a complete mathematical proof. Finite enumeration and an independent transfer recurrence supply supplementary consistency checks; neither is presented as an infinite proof. No assertion of independent audit or certification.
scientific_limitations: Cycles of order at least six; geodesics of length at most three; optimizers only. Independent replication and exhaustive historical priority verification not performed. Classical constrained circular-word enumerations may overlap under another vocabulary.
title: A mod-four census of optimal general three-position sets on cycles
